A bond of 60% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 144 aliases, and each one needs its own funded timber account. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
